status_semantics.pass: The lane completed and produced safe summaries or safe refs.
status_semantics.fail: The lane failed and blocks promotion until fixed.
status_semantics.skipped: A scoped optional prerequisite was unavailable and a safe reason code is recorded.
status_semantics.blocked: A required gate, approval, or prerequisite is missing.
status_semantics.accepted_failure: A reviewed failure is time-bound, owner-bound, evidence-bound, and recorded in this packet.

verification_lanes.safe_summary: Replace with the docs lane result summary for the release candidate.
Replace with the OpenAPI lane result summary for the release candidate.
Replace with the API safety lane result summary for the release candidate.
Replace with the security and redaction lane result summary for the release candidate.
Replace with the product-truth regression lane result summary for the release candidate.
Use skipped only when local prerequisites are unavailable and a safe reason code is recorded.
Replace with the durability lane result summary for the release candidate.
Replace with the frontend lane result summary for the release candidate.
Replace with the visual regression lane result summary for the release candidate, using redacted screenshot/hash refs only.
Replace with the desktop/local packaging proof lane result summary without public distribution or signed installer claims.
Replace with the performance lane result summary for the release candidate.

report_refs.safe_summary: Replace with the redacted Foundation Gate result summary.
Replace with p50/p95 status and safe report refs only.

artifact_hashes.safe_summary: Replace with a reviewed artifact hash for the release candidate.

release_blockers.blocking_gate: Populate the packet from actual release-candidate verification results.
release_blockers.safe_summary: This template is not a release packet until concrete safe refs and results replace placeholders.

rollback_notes.safe_summary: Rollback this format by removing the packet doc, schema, template, verifier, tests, and index links.

non_goals: No production authority is granted by this packet format.
No public release, public distribution, signed installer, or hosted production support is claimed.
No shell execution, subprocess execution, connector writes, plugin runtime import, mobile control, broad autonomy, or autonomous background execution is enabled.
No raw prompts, raw responses, raw provider payloads, raw paths, raw logs, usernames, hostnames, serial numbers, environment dumps, or credential material are allowed.
